hypothesis: After the first integration failed at n=65536, this revision retains the best measured 4096-element, two-pass hierarchy but uses only the warp-local shuffle idea for tile reduction. A serial 64-bit combine of the four warp sums avoids the unconfirmed cross-warp XOR path; the separate finalizer also retains 64-bit accumulation. Whether this composition is faster remains for the controller to measure.
notes: The previous integration attempt d441ab81063e4ce5-h01 was incorrect at n=65536 (seed 23; maximum absolute error 760). This retry avoids its XOR cross-warp combine. The current proposal has no measured correctness or performance result; no speedup is claimed. T3's cooperative candidates were correct but much slower than baseline, so they are not included.
transformations: Retain the 4096-element tile and two-pass hierarchy with one CTA per first-pass tile and one finalizer CTA.
Replace the tile CTA's shared-memory tree with five warp shuffle-down steps, then serially combine four warp partials in 64-bit shared memory.
Keep first-pass partials and final-pass accumulation 64-bit, while bounding each thread's first-pass signed local sum by the tile size.
Preserve tail bounds, empty-input zeroing, n=1 device copy, ABI, default-stream ordering, and scratch-only partial storage.
